title: Dedicated -> Hosted spill protection: reservation-aware admission control and retry-quarantine
creator: Leila Moreno
description: Summary: During a customer migration from Dedicated capacity to Hosted (failover exercise) we observed a correlated burst of long-lived streaming and multipart requests that caused connection queue saturation, KV-cache thrashing, and a spike of 5xx / timeouts across hosted routing. Root causes: 1) admission control at the edge did not apply Dedicated reservation tokens and allowed an immediate spill of sustained load into hosted workers; 2) client + SDK retries amplified the load without backoff alignment; 3) in-flight streaming requests caused head-of-line blocking and connection pool exhaustion. This ticket implements a two-part mitigation: (A) reservation-aware admission control at the front-door to honor Dedicated reservations and shed overflow gracefully, and (B) a short-duration tenant-level "retry-quarantine" that limits retry amplification from a misbehaving tenant while preserving in-flight traffic and providing a traceable timeline for customer comms.
acceptance_criteria: Admission proxy drops or queues excess requests when Dedicated reservations are saturated; reservation tokens are logged and tagged in traces.
Retry-quarantine prevents >x retries/sec from the same tenant for 30s windows without causing legitimate in-flight requests to abort.
End-to-end canary shows 80% reduction in 5xx events for simulated Dedicated->Hosted spill scenario compared to baseline.
New telemetry (reservation_hit/reservation_miss, quarantine_activated) visible in Console dashboards and alerts added for sustained reservation miss rates.
Customer communication template and runbook created; SRE sign-off for rollout gates.
Rollback plan validated: ability to disable admission change via feature flag and immediately lift quarantine policy without data loss.
tasks: Design: finalize admission logic and token propagation spec (edge, proxy, runtime)
Implement: edge-proxy reservation-aware admission + flags (code + unit tests)
Implement: retry-quarantine microservice/shim with metrics and trace tags
SDK: publish guidance for backoff alignment and add optional client-side jitter helper
E2E: build replay-proxy reproducer to simulate Dedicated->Hosted spill and deterministic traffic shapes
QA: run canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with synthetic tenants and one customer sandbox
Observability: add dashboard panels and alert thresholds, wire telemetry into Console
Docs & comms: customer-facing status note, escalation template, postmortem checklist
